_comment: Hand corrections applied by build_cardio_buckets.py when it builds cardio-buckets.csv. Keyed by Garmin activity ID. keep = [from, to] inclusive minute window; set_hr = treat a minute range as a given HR (sensor misread); add = extra minutes at a given HR (watch paused). See the docstring in build_cardio_buckets.py.

24484914406.note: 2026-09-24 Portofino treadmill. Watch under-read on the left wrist 12:42-12:59 during the 3.6 mph / 10% incline stretch (post-wrist-switch readings were ~125-135), and tracking was left running ~25 min after getting off.

24509403359.note: 2026-09-26 Portofino Peloton ride. Watch left recording ~3 h after the ride; trimmed to the actual ride window 11:26 AM-12:04 PM.

24609293314.note: 2026-10-04 Miami Beach walk. Watch was paused ~10:05-10:14 PM while still walking; HR was 81-88 either side of the pause.
